description: MenuFresh is a cost and profit management service for restaurants. Just talk to ChatGPT to register ingredients, recipes, and menu items, check cost ratios and margins, see how purchase-price changes affect each dish, explore pricing, and record stocktakes. No POS required — MenuFresh calculates the true profit of every dish from your menu and ingredient data. Review daily purchase and price changes in conversation, not at closing time.
